verificationArtifact.decision: Circom Groth16 (same zkeys as Base) + Solana alt_bn128 syscalls; pending-inputs PDA for 25 limbs; 14 VK accounts routed like SpendActionGroth16Router. Relayer-trust and pure-BPF fakes forbidden.
verificationArtifact.publicInputsDelivery: pending-inputs PDA (25×32 bytes) — proof-only in spend tx; classic 1232B envelope cannot hold 25 limbs + proof inline
verificationArtifact.vkStorage: one account (or const) per action circuit; route like SpendActionGroth16Router
verificationArtifact.cuBudgetNote: Light benches ~78–109k CU for 1–8 publics; expect ~180–200k for 25 — re-bench Siphon vkeys before mainnet

onChainBinding.payeePayout: require(publicInputs[15] == payeeId(rawPayeePubkey)); transfer SPL/native to pubkey
